shot: The kitchen's cooking menu open on a recipe you know, with its ingredients showing.
how: Farmhouse kitchen, interact with the stove.

shot: Eating a cooked dish while out working, with the energy meter visible.
how: Any dish from your satchel, mid-day when energy is low.

shot: Your own garden beds with crops at different growth stages.
how: Stand at the edge of your field so several rows fit in frame.

shot: Lina's seed list at Dahl General Store, with prices showing.
how: Talk to Lina and open the shop menu.

shot: One of your fruit trees with fruit on it, ready to pick.
how: Any tree you've planted on the farm.

shot: Tara mid-cast at a fishing spot you like.
how: Any spot from the Fishing Map; the dock or a river is fine.

shot: The catch screen for a fish you landed, ideally one of the rarer ones.
how: Press Capture the moment the catch pops up.

shot: The bait selection or the bait in your inventory before casting.
how: Open your inventory with bait in it.

shot: A resident's profile page showing their favorite gifts, some still hidden as silhouettes.
how: Relationships menu, pick a Year 1 resident (not Eury or anyone from Ravenwood Hollow).

shot: Handing a resident one of their favorites and their happy reaction.
how: Use the gift icon while talking to them.

shot: Inside your tool shed with as many stations built as you have.
how: Walk in and stand near the door so the whole room shows.

shot: The loom menu turning cotton into cloth.
how: Interact with the loom with cotton in your inventory.

shot: One of your beehives surrounded by blooming flowers.
how: Your garden, in a season when your flowers are blooming.

shot: The cauldron's brewing menu open on a potion you can make.
how: The cauldron in Hazel's basement.

shot: Your list of learned spells or incantations.
how: Open the spells menu after you've learned a few.

shot: Rain falling on your planted fields after casting Summon Rain.
how: Cast it in the evening, then capture the rain on your crops.

shot: Flying your broom over the island, with something recognizable below.
how: Any flight; the lighthouse or the farm makes a good backdrop.

shot: Breaking rocks inside the mine, with the floor number on screen if it shows.
how: Any floor; deeper is more interesting.

shot: Natalia's smelting or tool-upgrade menu.
how: Visit the blacksmith with ore in your inventory.

shot: Your barn or coop with your animals in it.
how: Morning, before you let them out.

shot: The journal open on your to-do list.
how: Any point in Year 1; avoid quest names past Chapter 1 if you can.

shot: Normal gameplay with the energy meter and clock clearly visible.
how: Anywhere outdoors in daylight.

shot: The in-game map screen.
how: Open the map from the menu.

shot: Violet's pattern list at her boutique, with prices showing.
how: Talk to Violet once she sells outfit designs.

shot: Tara wearing an outfit you sewed yourself.
how: Anywhere with a nice background.

shot: Your whole farm from the highest point you can reach (the broom works well).
how: Any season; a second one in another season is a bonus.

shot: Any festival in progress in town.
how: Whichever festival comes up next for you.

shot: Cleocatra, anywhere she's being regal.
how: Around the farmhouse.
